name: Gitea and Forgejo
summary: Sign in to gitea.com, Codeberg and other Gitea and Forgejo servers, clone from your accounts and open links.

capabilities.reason: Talks to the Gitea and Forgejo servers you add to sign you in and list repositories.
Keeps your Gitea and Forgejo sign-ins in your system's secret store.
Opens your Gitea or Forgejo server in your browser to sign in.
Remembers the accounts you added and caches avatars.
Reads a variable that points it at a test server during development.
